name: alienfast-claude
description: Mods that ship with the alienfast ~/.claude config

plugins.name: effort-phase
plugins.description: Main-loop effort per request by skill phase, with a per-step usage ledger

plugins.name: spawn-policy
plugins.description: Role-to-model tiers and synchronous review dispatch enforced on agent.spawn

plugins.name: effort-probe
plugins.description: Measures whether a turn.step effort rewrite preserves the prompt cache

plugins.name: loop-boundary
plugins.description: Compacts the main conversation to a near-clear at each /loop /auto iteration boundary, with a per-boundary ledger

plugins.name: loop-boundary-probe
plugins.description: Measures where a plugin compaction is accepted and what origin a /loop wakeup carries

plugins.name: rate-limits
plugins.description: Writes the account's rate-limit windows to ~/.claude/local/rate-limits.json on every measurement, for the weekly readout at fleet launch
